heading: Creative instinct. Technical follow-through.
paragraphs: I’m Merwin, a digital creative from Batangas and the person behind ERO | VISUALS. I grew a solo content operation from zero while building software that solves real problems.
That experience taught me how to learn independently, work through unclear problems, document decisions, and deliver without needing constant supervision.
